models.label: Kokoro 82M (PyTorch)

license.voices: Apache-2.0 package grant; no separate per-voice manifest is published

models.distribution: downloaded by huggingface_hub at first use; not bundled
models.integrity_status: upstream revision is not pinned by the application
models.smoke_test: Initialize KPipeline and generate non-empty 24 kHz audio with af_heart
models.migration: Keep the existing Hugging Face cache until a pinned replacement loads
models.rollback: Select the prior application version; cached upstream files are not deleted automatically
